s: Zeman hanachatan ubo h' seipim: layla zeman tepillin hu min hattora, shezzeh shenneemar: "veshamarta et hachuqqa hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima", shemmashmao yamim velo lelot — en hakkatub medabber bechuqqat hattepillin, ella bechuqqat happesach shenneemar lemala: "veabadta et haaboda hazzot vego'". Abal chakamim aseru lehaniach tepillin ballayla, mippene shehu zeman shena, ugezera shemma yishkach veyishan bahem, veasur lishon bitpillin mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman mad. Velaken ap leachar sheala ammud hashshachar, shehu yom lekol hammitzvot haamurot battora — asur lahanichan ad shettaggia et qima mishshena lerob bene adam, dehaynu ad sheyyair hayyom bikde sheyyireh et chabero berichuq arba ammot veyakkirennu, vehu sheyyihyeh chabero haragil immo qetzat, sheillu ragil immo harbeh — yakkirennu apillu merachoq, veim eno ragil immo kelal — lo yakkirennu apillu beqarob meod:

Im henichan qodem tzet hakkokabim vechoshka alayv, apillu hen alayv kol hallayla — muttar, veen morin ken halaka lemaaseh, shemma yabou lahanichan lekattechilla ballayla. Velaken lo yaaseh ken ella beno leben atzmo, abal lo barabbim, shemma yitu lomar shemmuttar lahanichan lekattechilla ballayla. Ella im ken hu bebet hammidrash, shebbeyoshebe bet hammidrash en lachosh sheyyitu. Veim lo chalatz tepillayv keshehiggia tzet hakkokabim mippene shello haya lo maqom leshomran venimtzeu alayv kede leshomran — muttar, umorin ken (vetzarik sheyyomar laroim sheoseh kede leshomran). Abal asur lahanichan alayv lekattechilla ballayla kede leshomran (veim menichan alayv mibbeod yom bishbil sheyyihyu alayv ballayla kede leshomran — muttar, veen morin ken lahanichan lekattechilla bishbil kak):

Haya rotzeh latzet ladderek bahashkama qodem sheyyair hayyom — yakol lahanichan qodem yetziato, ukeshemmaggia zemanno — yemashmesh bahen vibarek, sheen lachosh shemma yishan bahem, kevan shehishkim veyatza ladderek. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beholek beraglayv, sheeno yakol lishon behilluko, abal harokeb o yosheb beqaron, sheyyukal lishon — asur lahanichan qodem zemannan:

Haya ba badderek utepillin berosho veshoqa alayv chamma, dehaynu tzet hakkokabim, veeno rotzeh lecholtzan velissa otan beyado shemma yippelu miyyado — manniach yado alehem ad shemmaggia lebeto, mippene haroim, shello yitu lomar muttar lehaniach tepillin lekattechilla ballayla. Veken hayyosheb bebet hammidrash utepillin berosho, veqadash alayv bearbe shabbatot veyamim tobim sheen zeman tepillin, veeno yakol lachalotz velahanichan sham bebet hammidrash shebbassadeh, mippene sheeno maqom hammishtammer — manniach yado alehen ad sheyyabo lebeto, shemmishshum bizyon hattepillin hittiru lehaknisan derek malbush lair. Veim yesh bayit qarob lachoma shemmishtammerin sham — choletzan umannichan sham, velo yelek bahen yoter bair, ben belele shabbatot veyamim tobim ben belele hachol:

Mi sheshshakach velo heniach tepillin kol hayyom venizkar achar shehitpallel tepillat arbit mibbeod yom — yesh mi sheomer sheasur lo lahanichan az, lepi shekkebar asao lizman zeh layla (uzeman shekiba biqriat shema utepilla shel arbit). Veim yaniach bo tepillin — yachazor veyaasehu yom, vahare hen shette qullot shessoterot zo et zo. Abal im hu lo hitpallel adayin, apillu hatztzibbur hitpallelu — en bekak kelum, kevan shehu en oseh shette qullot shessoterin zu et zu. Veyesh mi shecholeq al zeh.
